plugins.name: issue-board
plugins.description: The repository's open GitHub issues and pull requests in a pane and under the prompt, with acceptance progress and CI, and a button that hands an issue to Claude.

plugins.name: ask
plugins.description: Ask Claude a side question or for prompt ideas; it answers in a pane, in the background, and nothing lands in the chat.

plugins.name: ouroboros
plugins.description: A harness that rewrites itself: it records where a session goes wrong, has a subagent write a hook that fixes it, tests that hook, and installs it as a plugin of its own once you accept it.

plugins.name: ouroboros-gene-validate-plugin-on-edit
plugins.description: Validate a plugin right after editing its files
